headline: Report: Flyers’ Matvei Michkov wants ‘a new start elsewhere’
take: Daily Faceoff passes on Kevin Weekes' report that Matvei Michkov wants "a new start elsewhere," the loudest turn yet in a month of headlines about his ice time. Our numbers explain both sides. Michkov has 10 goals and 14 points in 20 games while playing 15.9 minutes a night, and seven of his points have come on the power play. He is also scoring well above his chances (4.5 goals more than expected), and at five on five the Flyers get just 40.5% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice. A coach can read that as a defensive problem; a player can read it as being buried on a team at 43.7% overall. Either way, the 2023 No. 7 pick is the rebuild's centerpiece, and this is now the Flyers' biggest story.
